senses.gloss:
देय a. [दा कर्मणि यत्]
1 To be
given, offered or presented;
R. 3. 16.
--2 Fit to be given, proper for
a gift.
--3 To be returned or
restored; विभावितैकदेशेन देयं यदभियुज्यते
V. 4. 17; Ms. 8. 139, 185.
--4
To be shown.
--5 To be given in
marriage.
--6 To be paid (as a debt
&c.).
--7 To be placed, put, applied,
laid, &c.; see दा above.
--यं A gift,
donation.
